role_contract.joy: sustained happy dialogue with open eyes

style_review: Neutral face samples of all 20 directly inspected. Smooth illustrative linework; no visible coarse repeated dot grid. All120 fail exact2px-repeat test, a supporting check not a complete visual art audit.
resolution_note: Some retained originals are lower resolution; native bytes preserved, no upscaling or regeneration. Preview resizing only.
runtime_note: Use smooth texture sampling, not pixel/nearest rendering. Preserve per-character size and pose anchors; do not infer runtime sizing from comparison sheets.
